verdict.rationale: Reflect's AI palette lets users type natural-language prompts/questions and 'chat' with notes to extract info or summarize, which is a form of NL interaction, but this is limited to content Q&A/summarization rather than general app operation (e.g., navigation, note creation/tagging, settings) via natural language — actual app actions are driven by structured deep-link commands (reflect://...&command=), not NL. Missing for 10: evidence of NL commands controlling broader app actions (creating/organizing notes, executing deep-link-style commands via natural language), voice-command execution beyond transcription, and independent hands-on confirmation of the AI palette's command scope.
